purpose: find out how the system performs under expected and peak use against stated objectives, and where it degrades first
entry_criteria: Performance objectives are defined (latency, throughput, error rate)
A production-like test environment and data volume exist
procedure: Model the workload from real traffic: operation mix, think times and data distribution.
Prepare data volumes close to production and warm the system as in production.
Run baseline, expected-peak and stress scenarios; capture latency percentiles, throughput, errors and resource use.
Find the first bottleneck by correlating results with metrics, profiles and database behavior.
Fix or record the bottleneck, rerun, and compare to the baseline with the same workload.
Report against the objectives, including limits of the test environment.
acceptance_criteria: The workload comes from production data
Environment differences from production are listed

validation.expect: p95 latency and error rate meet thresholds

validation.check: compare the test environment's size and data volume with production

failure_modes.detection: Database is a fraction of production size

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A peak scenario at 300 requests per second keeps p95 latency at 420 ms against a 500 ms objective until the database connection pool saturates at 380; the report names the pool as the first bottleneck.
